gallery.alt: Two tone gold band lying on a pale blue-grey tile: white gold rails edged with milgrain, a domed yellow gold centre and nine round lab-grown diamonds channel set across the front.
Close view of the nine round lab-grown diamonds set side by side in the channel of the domed yellow gold centre, framed by white gold rails with fine milgrain bead lines, over blue-grey slate.
The band standing on light indigo chambray, its row of round lab-grown diamonds along the upper part of the ring and the rest of the band plain white gold milgrain rails and polished yellow gold.
A man's hand resting on charcoal grey wool by a window, wearing the two tone band on the ring finger with its row of lab-grown diamonds across the top of the finger.
The plain back of the band over pale concrete: two white gold rails, two fine milgrain bead lines and the softly domed, polished yellow gold centre between them.
The band standing upright on charcoal slate, seen edge-on: its 7 mm width across the white gold rails, milgrain lines and domed yellow gold centre, with the first stones of the row at the top.
The band lying on matte black basalt, its nine round lab-grown diamonds channel set in the yellow gold centre between the white gold milgrain rails.
The band resting in a man's open palm to show its size, its row of round lab-grown diamonds facing up.
Close view of the end of the stone row: the last round lab-grown diamonds, the channel closing in a rounded end and the plain domed yellow gold beyond it, between white gold milgrain rails.
Drawing of the band from the top and in cross-section: about 7 mm wide and 2 mm thick, nine round lab-grown diamonds of about 2.75 mm in one channel, in 10K, 14K or 18K, US 4 to US 16.
The ring on a blue holder over a white paper towel, close up: round lab-grown diamonds side by side in the channel, its rounded end in the yellow gold centre and the white gold milgrain rails.
